mapper.sql: pc.id, pc.agent_id, pc.product_id, pc.profit_rate, pc.create_time, pc.update_time, a.agent_name as agent_name, p.product_name as product_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM profit_configs pc LEFT JOIN agents a ON pc.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN products p ON pc.product_id = p.id WHERE pc.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM profit_configs pc LEFT JOIN agents a ON pc.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN products p ON pc.product_id = p.id WHERE pc.agent_id = #{agentId} AND pc.product_id = #{productId}
SELECT FROM profit_configs pc LEFT JOIN agents a ON pc.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN products p ON pc.product_id = p.id WHERE pc.agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profit_configs (agent_id, product_id, profit_rate, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{productId}, #{profitRate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE profit_configs SET agent_id = #{agentId}, product_id = #{productId}, profit_rate = #{profitRate}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
